assessment.why: She uniquely claims placement of recovery-picture bottle and touched donor glass. Her label of it as copy may be mistaken or false. Without identification/toxicology, this is a provisional lead; Brie and Chip offer substantial access alternatives.

plausibility_notes: Repeated admissions and selective-document defenses feel deliberately balanced. Bottle-copy claim is the most useful testable statement so far.
